situation.name: zombie_swarm_spatial_pde
situation.description: Spatial zombie model with nonlocal advection and diffusion. Incorporates social interaction kernels for repulsion (susceptibles avoid zombies) and attraction (zombies attracted to susceptibles). Reaction-diffusion-advection PDE system on a periodic domain.

data.name: spatial_zombie_simulation
data.source: Mathematical Modelling of Zombies, University of Ottawa Press

compartments.name: zombies
compartments.expression: dZ/dt = -div(Z * (K_Z * S)) + D_Z * Z_xx + beta*S*Z + R - alpha*S*Z

params.name: zombie_destruction_rate
params.meaning: Rate at which susceptibles destroy zombies

params.name: removal_rate
params.meaning: Rate at which removed individuals are permanently removed (rescaled to 1)

params.name: susceptible_repulsion_kernel
params.meaning: Repulsive social interaction kernel (susceptibles avoid zombies)

params.name: zombie_attraction_kernel
params.meaning: Attractive social interaction kernel (zombies attracted to susceptibles)

params.name: repulsion_strength
params.meaning: Strength of zombie attraction to susceptibles

params.name: kernel_range_zombie
params.meaning: Range parameter for zombie attraction kernel

situation.name: zombie_swarm_cure_spatial
situation.description: Spatial zombie model with cure. Cured zombies return to susceptible class. Includes cure rate c.

data.name: spatial_zombie_cure_simulation
data.source: Mathematical Modelling of Zombies, University of Ottawa Press

compartments.name: susceptible_humans
compartments.expression: dS/dt = -div(S * (K_S * Z)) + D_S * S_xx - beta*S*Z + c*Z

compartments.name: zombies
compartments.expression: dZ/dt = -div(Z * (K_Z * S)) + D_Z * Z_xx + beta*S*Z + R - alpha*S*Z - c*Z

params.name: zombie_destruction_rate
params.meaning: Rate at which susceptibles destroy zombies

params.name: cure_rate
params.meaning: Rate at which zombies are cured and become susceptible
